spec_input: Build a URL shortener with FastAPI backend, React frontend, PostgreSQL for storage, per-link hit count analytics. Must support custom aliases and 30-day link expiration.

specification.description: A URL shortener with FastAPI backend, React frontend, and PostgreSQL storage, supporting custom aliases and 30-day link expiration.
acceptance_criteria: User can create a new shortened URL with a custom alias.
User can view the hit count for a shortened URL.

clarifications.question: What is the expected format for custom aliases (e.g., alphanumeric, alphanumeric with dashes, etc.)?
How should the system handle link expiration (e.g., automatically delete expired links, send notifications, etc.)?
What are the core features of the URL shortener (e.g., link creation, alias management, analytics, etc.)?
clarifications.answer: link creation, custom alias, expiration, hit count
